content.value: A multimode step index fiber has numerical aperture of 0.2 and core refractive index of 1.48. Estimate the insertion loss at a joint in fiber caused by a $5 ^ { \circ }$ angular misalignment of the fiber core axes. It may be assumed that the medium between the fibers is air.
